changelog: Complete Xiaomi HyperOS 3.0 overhaul for AuraOS 3.0 (Aura 15T Pro): split Control Center, HyperOS notification cards, HyperIsland pill, squircle icons, lock screen, Settings, and dedicated Calendar, Clock, Weather, Notes, and Reminders apps.
Fixed Control Center and Notification Shade visibility in AuraOS without breaking Nova UI.
Fixed Maps with a compact default bottom sheet, quick category chips, and tap-anywhere custom pin placement for GPS routing.
